# Alien Plugg — x402 API Endpoints for AI Agents

> What I have is outta this world 👽🌌

38 paid x402 API endpoints + MCP server with 10 curated tools. Flat $0.003/call. USDC micropayments on Base. Automatic x402 protocol — no manual signing.

## Categories
- **Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens** (6 endpoints) — tokenized stock prices, catalog, screener, corporate actions, DEX scanner, trending scanner
- **Zora Crypto Analysis** (10 endpoints) — scanner, rug check, sentiment, portfolio, holders, honeypot, creator lookup, new launches, chart roast, token compare
- **On-Chain Intelligence** (7 endpoints) — token price, whale tracker, smart money, wallet profile, gas tracker, tx status, builder score
- **Alerts** (4 endpoints) — price alerts, whale alerts, rug alerts, launch alerts
- **Utilities** (5 endpoints) — translate, IP info, URL expander, tech stack detect, webpage diff
- **Premium Alpha** (2 endpoints) — daily alpha report, pro alpha with technicals
- **DEX Analysis** (1 endpoint) — Uniswap V3 liquidity flow
- **Discovery** (3 free/low-cost) — discovery catalog, MCP handshake, MCP server

## Base URL
```
https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/
```

## MCP Server (For AI Agents)
```
https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/mcp-server
```
Implements MCP protocol 2024-11-05. Free initialize, tools/list, resources/list. Paid tools/call at $0.003 USDC.
10 tools: zora-scanner, rh-stock-prices, token-price, zora-rug-check, zora-portfolio, whale-tracker, wallet-profile, gas-tracker, builder-score, alien-plugg-alpha.

## Quick Start
```
# Discover all endpoints (FREE)
curl https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/discovery

# Scan Zora for trending coins ($0.003)
curl https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/zora-scanner

# Get NVDA stock token price ($0.003)
curl https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/rh-stock-prices?symbol=NVDA
```

## All 38 Endpoints

### Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens

- rh-corporate-actions ($0.003) — Splits, dividends, mergers
- rh-stock-screener ($0.003) — Screen by volume, tradability
- rh-dex-scanner ($0.003) — Block activity on chain ID 4663
- robinhood-scanner ($0.003) — Trending RH tokens + signals

### Zora Crypto
- zora-scanner ($0.003) — Trending coins + BUY/SELL/STRONG_BUY
- new-launches ($0.003) — Freshest launches with age labels
- zora-rug-check ($0.003) — `?address=0x...` — 0-100 rug risk score
- zora-portfolio ($0.003) — `?address=0x...` — Holdings, PnL, allocation
- zora-sentiment ($0.003) — `?token=0x...` — Social sentiment scoring
- honeypot-check ($0.003) — `?token=0x...` — Honeypot detector
- holder-analysis ($0.003) — `?token=0x...` — Top holders, concentration
- creator-lookup ($0.003) — `?handle=alienplugg` — Creator profiles
- chart-roast ($0.003) — `?token=0x...` — Technical analysis + roasting
